description: The Vivo X Fold 5 comes loaded with a large 8.03-inch display when unfolded. The display offers up to 4,500nits of peak brightness, 412ppi pixel density, Dolby Vision, HDR10+, 120Hz screen refresh rate, and a resolution of 2200x2480 pixels. The cover screen comes with a 6.53-inch display with 1172 x 2748 pixel resolution. The Vivo X Fold 5 is powered by a slightly older Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 processor, which was also present in the X Fold 3. The handset comes with 16GB of LPDDR5X RAM and up to UFS 4.1 storage. It runs on Funtouch OS 15, which is based on the Android 15 operating system.
title: Vivo X Fold 5 Shows How Foldables Are Quietly Growing Up

description: Astronomers have discovered one of the oldest known stars, PicII-503, in the Pictor II dwarf galaxy. With extremely low iron content, the star offers rare insight into the second generation of stars and the early chemical evolution of the universe.
title: Ancient Star in Pictor II Reveals Secrets of Early Universe

description: Google has revamped the security policies on Android, with regard to apps that are downloaded through sources other than the Google Play Store. Among the major changes to ensure security is the implementation of a 24-hour waiting period to sideload apps from developers who are not verified. The company claims this measure aims to curb scams and malware attacks. While there are still a few months before the changes are implemented, this can be very frustrating for you if you frequently sideload apps on your Android device.
title: How to Bypass Android's 24-Hour Delay and Install Third-Party Apps on Your Phone

description: OnePlus 15T is set to be launched in China on March 24 at 7 pm local time (4:30 pm IST) by the smartphone maker as the latest addition to its lineup. The handset is currently on pre-order in the country via the Oppo China online store. It is confirmed to arrive in Healing White Chocolate, Pure Cocoa, and Relaxing Matcha (translated from Chinese) colourways. Moreover, it will be sold in 12GB + 256GB, 12GB + 512GB, 16GB + 256GB, 16GB + 512GB, and 16GB + 1TB RAM and storage configurations. The phone will be powered by a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: OnePlus 15T Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price and Specifications
